body: I'll align my format calls with the project-wide convention (`jiff::fmt::strtime::format(...).unwrap_or_default()`) adopted by other adapters, for consistency.

All assignment requirements are met. Summary of changes:

**`adapters/mod.rs`**: `MtrCtx::now()` → `jiff::Timestamp`, `MtrCtx::today()` → `jiff::civil::Date` (trait and other adapter modules untouched).

**`sinir/json_mtr.rs`**: epoch-ms → UTC `Date` via `Timestamp::from_millisecond` + `to_zoned_datetime(UTC)` (helper `data_de_millis`); `%d/%m/%Y` parsing via `strtime::parse(...).to_date()`.

**`sinir/json_listas.rs`**: `lista_cdf_emitido` takes `jiff::civil::Date`; same `%d/%m/%Y` parser.

**`sinir/json_escrita.rs`**: filter takes `Date`; `checked_sub(30.days())` with fallback; `%d-%m-%Y` formatting preserved via `jiff::fmt::strtime::format(...).unwrap_or_default()`; payload timestamps converted through `to_zoned_datetime(UTC)?.timestamp().as_millisecond()` (helper `millis_de_datetime`), keeping `dataRecebimento` always numeric.

**`sinir/download.rs`**: CDF `dataEmissao` uses `Date::at(0,0,0,0)` → UTC epoch ms, default 0.

**`sinir/testes.rs`**: fixture uses `jiff::civil::date(2026, 6, 1)`.

Remaining SINIR files (`json_residuos.rs`, `consulta.rs`, `escrita.rs`, `alteracao.rs`, `listas.rs`, `auth.rs`) had no chrono usages.
